name: ether.fi
description: ether.fi is a modern crypto neobank that replaces the traditional consumer bank. Users can save, grow, and spend their crypto through one connected experience. Common use cases include buying tokens, earning on crypto through vaults, sending money globally through fiat on and off ramps, and purchasing every day goods through a credit card.

methodology.UserFees: Percentage of rewards paid to protocol
methodology.Fees: Total rewards generated from ether.fi staking services: ETH staking, Eigenlayer restaking, validator operations
methodology.Revenue: Protocol's share of fees including management fees from staking/restaking and validator operations rewards
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: ether.fi's share of staking, restaking and validator rewards, plus eETH withdrawal fees, all kept by the protocol treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Portion of fees distributed to stakers.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: ETHFI bought back on the open market by ether.fi's treasury, plus monthly off-chain buybacks from July 2024 to April 2025; excludes ETHFI bought since September 2026 to fund ether.fi Cash cashback, which the ether.fi Cash listing counts as a cost.

Fees.Core ETH Staking Rewards: All rewards from core ETH staking, derived from the protocol fees paid by the liquidity pool (protocol fee represents ~10% of total staking rewards).
Fees.EigenLayer Staking Rewards: EigenLayer restaking rewards claimed weekly on Optimism (converted to daily), plus miscellaneous WETH/EIGEN transfers to the protocol treasury.
Fees.Restaker stETH Staking Rewards: Lido rebasing rewards accrued on the stETH/wstETH held by the EtherFiRestaker contract.
Fees.SSV Staking Rewards: SSV token rewards earned for running SSV-based validators.
Fees.Obol Staking Rewards: OBOL token rewards earned for running Obol-based validators.
Fees.Vault Withdraw Fees: Fees charged on eETH withdrawals, tracked as eETH transfers from the withdrawal queue to the treasury.

Revenue.Core ETH Staking Rewards: Protocol keeps ~10% of core ETH staking rewards.
Revenue.EigenLayer Staking Rewards: Protocol keeps ~11% of EigenLayer restaking rewards, plus all miscellaneous treasury transfers.
Revenue.Restaker stETH Staking Rewards: Protocol keeps a 2.5% share of the stETH staking rewards.
Revenue.SSV Staking Rewards: SSV validator rewards are retained by the protocol.
Revenue.Obol Staking Rewards: OBOL validator rewards are retained by the protocol.
Revenue.Vault Withdraw Fees: eETH withdrawal fees are retained by the protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Core ETH Staking Rewards: The ~90% of core ETH staking rewards distributed to stakers.
SupplySideRevenue.EigenLayer Staking Rewards: The ~89% of EigenLayer restaking rewards distributed to stakers.
SupplySideRevenue.Restaker stETH Staking Rewards: stETH rebasing rewards passed on to stakers (everything above the 2.5% protocol share).

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: ETHFI bought on the open market by ether.fi's treasury, plus monthly off-chain buybacks from July 2024 to April 2025; excludes ETHFI bought since September 2026 for ether.fi Cash cashback.

methodology.Fees: Total rewards generated from ether.fi liquid vaults: management fees and staking rewards on vault holdings
methodology.Revenue: Protocol's share of fees including liquid vault management fees
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue - all protocol earnings retained by ether.fi.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Portion of fees distributed to vault depositors.

Fees.Management Fees: Annualized management fees charged on the TVL of the liquid vaults, prorated daily.
Fees.Liquid Vaults stETH Staking Rewards: Lido rebasing rewards accrued on the stETH/wstETH held by the weETHs and weETHk vaults, including their restaked wstETH positions.

Revenue.Management Fees: All liquid vault management fees are retained by the protocol.
Revenue.Liquid Vaults stETH Staking Rewards: Protocol keeps a 2.5% share of the stETH staking rewards on vault holdings.

SupplySideRevenue.Liquid Vaults stETH Staking Rewards: stETH rebasing rewards passed on to vault depositors (everything above the 2.5% protocol share).

methodology.Fees: Total borrow interest generated from EtherFi Cash services on Scroll and OP Mainnet, including Cash borrows on the Aave V4 instance ether.fi operates, since 2026-08-04.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol's share of fees from borrow interest: all of it on the DebtManager, 80% of the liquidity fee on the Aave V4 instance.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue - all protocol earnings from EtherFi Cash on Scroll and OP Mainnet.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Interest to suppliers of the Aave V4 instance after the liquidity fee, and the Aave DAO's 20% of that fee.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: No revenue share to ETHFI holders

Fees.Borrow Interest: Interest earned from EtherFi Cash lending operations on Scroll and OP Mainnet
Fees.Aave V4 Yields: Borrow interest on the Aave V4 instance ether.fi operates on OP Mainnet

Revenue.Borrow Interest: Interest earned from EtherFi Cash lending operations on Scroll and OP Mainnet
Revenue.Aave V4 Hub Fees: ether.fi's 80% of the liquidity fee on its Aave V4 instance

ProtocolRevenue.Borrow Interest: Interest earned from EtherFi Cash lending operations on Scroll and OP Mainnet
ProtocolRevenue.Aave V4 Hub Fees: ether.fi's 80% of the liquidity fee on its Aave V4 instance

SupplySideRevenue.Aave V4 Yields Distributed To Suppliers: Interest paid to suppliers of the Aave V4 instance after the liquidity fee
SupplySideRevenue.Aave V4 Hub Fees To Aave DAO: The Aave DAO's 20% of the liquidity fee on the instance

methodology.Volume: Card spending volume on EtherFi Cash.
methodology.Fees: Estimated 1.38% transaction fee on EtherFi Cash card spending, plus cashback paid to card users.
methodology.Revenue: Estimated 1.38% transaction fee on card spending.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Estimated 1.38% transaction fee on card spending, kept by ether.fi.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Cashback paid to card users: stablecoin or ETH cashback through the Cash contract, and ETHFI cashback bought with card revenue and paid through the CashbackDistributor.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: No revenue is distributed to ETHFI holders.

Fees.Cash Transaction Fees: Estimated 1.38% transaction fee on card spending
Fees.Cashbacks: Cashback paid to card users through the Cash contract and ETHFI cashback through the CashbackDistributor

Revenue.Cash Transaction Fees: Estimated 1.38% transaction fee on card spending

ProtocolRevenue.Cash Transaction Fees: Estimated 1.38% transaction fee on card spending

SupplySideRevenue.Cashbacks: Cashback paid to card users through the Cash contract and ETHFI cashback through the CashbackDistributor

SupplySideRevenue.FX & cross-border costs: Paid offchain and vary by region and charge type, so the amount cannot be measured onchain.
SupplySideRevenue.Card issuer & network costs: Revenue is estimated at 1.38% of card spend. Card issuer and network (Visa) fees come out of this, plus fees ether.fi pays its card program provider, Rain. All set in private contracts and paid offchain.
